description: Get one campaign with its settings, its steps in order and its sending mailboxes. `audience` counts its leads by where each address stands now, each lead once: `suppressed`, `invalid` (known invalid, including an address on a reserved domain such as .local), `invalidForNow` (our own look at the domain found no mail route; checked again after 24 hours), `eligible`, `review` (a fresh check said risky or couldn't tell, and the campaign's switch for it is off), and `held` by why it waits for a fresh check. `audience` is null when the leads couldn't be counted just now: ask again in a moment. `sendingWait` is set when a running campaign sends nothing more for now because the API key that launched it has sent all the emails its owner allows it in a day (`blockedBy: "key_day"`); the key's day starts over at `resetsAt`, and the campaign sends again in its next sending window after that. `engagement` says what came back, in people rather than emails: how many it emailed, replied, opened and clicked; per step (`steps`) only emailed, opened and clicked, since a reply answers the campaign, not a step; and the pages people clicked through to in the last 90 days (`linksWindowDays`; older clicks are deleted), with their link text. Only what a person did counts: never a mail scanner or an image proxy, never an open within 60 seconds or a click within 30 seconds of the email leaving (a filter looking at it, not a person reading it), and never two links from one network within 5 seconds of each other. An open is the email's image loading, so a person who reads with images off never counts: an open count is a floor, not a read rate. Opens and clicks count only while the campaign tracks them and one of the workspace's tracking domains is in use (list_tracking_domains' `inUse`): until then its emails carry no tracking, and a 0 means nothing was measured; `openedByMachinesOnly` counts the people whose emails only machines opened. `openTracked` and `clickTracked` count the people sent at least one email that could count an open (it carried the tracking image) or a click (its links went through the tracking domain). A rate is `opened` over `openTracked` or `clicked` over `clickTracked`, never over `emailed`, and there is none while the base is 0. `opened` is a floor, not a read rate: a lead who read with images off is in `emailed` and never in `opened`. A campaign in another workspace answers 404.
name: get_campaign
title: Get a campaign
